name: a record entry of one tab
why: The third spelling: one tab, which no renderer shows at all, so the entry under the headline would be empty on the page. A tab is a control character, and a control character is outside the characters a fact may carry wherever in a value it sits rather than only when it is the whole of one (decided on #27, 28 Oct 2026) -- so this is refused by code point before the blank rule is reached.
